response.original_title: {Travel Inquiry Keywords} Can You Add a Passenger to a Marella Cruise After Booking?
response.overview: Yes, you can add a passenger to an existing Marella Cruises booking, provided your stateroom has available berth capacity, the ship has open safety and lifeboat limits, and you process the change through customer support or your travel agent. Passenger additions cannot be processed online through the website or mobile app.+1-866- 259-1002(US/𝙲𝚊𝚗𝚊𝚍𝚊) How to Do It Call Customer Service+1-866- 259-1002(US/𝙲𝚊𝚗𝚊𝚍𝚊) Contact Your Travel Agent: If you booked through a third-party travel agent or tour operator, you must ask them to process the change. +1-866- 259-1002(US/𝙲𝚊𝚗𝚊𝚍𝚊) Important Details to Know Cabin & Lifeboat Capacity: Adding a guest depends on whether your stateroom has physical accommodations for an extra person (such as a sofa bed or Pullman bed) and whether the ship's total lifeboat/safety capacity allows it. +1-866- 259-1002(US/𝙲𝚊𝚗𝚊𝚍𝚊) Separate Staterooms:numbers. +1-866- 259-1002(US/𝙲𝚊𝚗𝚊𝚍𝚊)
